scope: uncalibrated numerical analogue; no experimental fit

assumptions.initial_fill: 60 grains from independent seeded mixture ordering; identical paired states across obstacle conditions
assumptions.obstacle_frame: left outlet edge; positive outward; center=(-D/2-q*dFG,RFG), ideal floor y=0
assumptions.startup: gate removed at 0.05s; no vibration or recirculation
assumptions.termination: fixed 1.0s observation; finite arch requires persistent structure and quiet state over 0.4s
assumptions.ejection: unique first downward center crossing of y=0 inside outlet; actual particle mass
assumptions.normalization: ratio of group mean fixed-horizon ejected masses, with matched no-obstacle controls; NOT source five-second avalanche mass
assumptions.position_selection: post-inspection of published curve; not independent validation or optimization

profile_stop.rule: Do not dispatch remaining runs after immediate complete finite-fill exhaustion or numerical profile failure
